steps:
3. Disable or Update ADP Integrations to Point to Test Environment
Procedure
Open Navigator from the upper-left corner.
Expand My Client Groups.
Click Data Exchange.
In the HCM Extracts section located in the center of the page, click Extract Definitions.
Click Show Filters near the upper-right section.
Set Legislative Data Group to US Legislative Data Group.
Search for Payslip.
Click the Payslip extract row from the results table.
In the left-side navigation panel, click Deliver.
Locate ADP_SC_GarnOnly_Payslip in the delivery options table.
Open the delivery option.
Set End Date to 01/01/2001.
Click OK in the lower-right corner of the popup.
Scroll to the Report Categories section.
Expand Additional Details.
Select ADP_SC_GarnOnly_Payslip.
Click Delete located above or beside the Additional Details table.
Click Validate in the upper-right toolbar.
Click Done near the upper-right area.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
